messages:
Jordan Lee: Hi all — got my MBP (13-inch, M2) and went through Setup Assistant but it never finished the "Allow remote management" step. Stuck on a spinner and says "management not completed". Connected to office WiFi (Office-WiFi). macOS 13.6.1. Anyone run into this?
IT Support: Welcome Jordan! Can you grab the serial and tell us whether you're on the wired network or WiFi? Any VPN/proxy in place?
Jordan Lee: Serial C02Y9Z8ABCD1, on WiFi. No VPN but our office wifi uses an inline web proxy that pops up for SSO on first use. I clicked through the captive portal before starting setup.
network-bot: [network-check] Office-WiFi: captive_portal_seen=true; proxy_auto_config=enabled; proxy_host=10.10.0.5; https_blocklist=false
IT Support: That proxy can interrupt the MDM TLS handshake during enrollment. Two quick checks: can you hold on to the setup screen and switch to your phone hotspot? If not, we can remote-assign the device in Jamf/Kandji and try a forced enrollment.
Jordan Lee: I can try hotspot. Switching to phone hotspot now.
IT Support: Before rebooting, if you can drop to Terminal (Cmd+Option+F?) on the setup assistant, run:
```bash
# check network reachability
ping -c 3 mdm.kandji.io || echo unreachable
# try renewing enrollment
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
Jordan Lee: Terminal available. ping shows unreachable when on Office-WiFi. profiles renew returns "Enrollment operation failed: TLS handshake error"
Taylor: @IT Support if TLS fails on WiFi but works on hotspot it's definitely proxy breaking the SCEP/MDM cert exchange. We can whitelist the MDN endpoints, but that's a change request. Easier: finish setup on hotspot then we'll retro-provision the device to the network.
Jordan Lee: Booted into hotspot — ping works and profiles renew now hangs for a bit then returns "Enrollment successful". Back to setup and it progressed past remote management.
IT Support: Great. Reboot once it's completed and check filevault status:
```bash
sudo fdesetup status
# expected: FileVault is On
```
Jordan Lee: Rebooted. fdesetup status -> FileVault is On. Jamf/Kandji now show device as supervised and compliant.
Emma (People Ops): Awesome — welcome Jordan! We'll swing by your desk to hand you the docking cable. If you want, ping #devex for a dotfiles setup script.
Jordan Lee: Thanks everyone, saved my morning. Will file a ticket about the captive portal interfering with device enroll so IT can whitelist endpoints. :thumbsup:
